description: This file declares the RDKWindowManager class, which implements plugin and JSON RPC interfaces for managing window-related functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It also defines an internal Notification class for handling remote connection events and user inactivity notifications.

classes.name: RDKWindowManager
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing plugin and JSON RPC interfaces, managing window services, and handling notifications.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Internal class for handling remote connection notifications and user inactivity events, associated with RDKWindowManager.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.
